header.userPrompt: Add a sample of Scala3 Intersection type

resultJson.title: Add Scala 3 intersection types sample
resultJson.body:
Adds a sample showing Scala 3 intersection types (`A & B`), as requested ("Add a sample of Scala3 Intersection type").

The new `intersectiontypes/IntersectionTypes.scala` covers:
- a parameter that must be both `Named` and `Aged`, and that `A & B` and `B & A` are interchangeable
- using members from both sides with `Resettable & Growable[Int]`
- an anonymous object that satisfies an intersection directly
- a `@main` demo, `intersectionTypesDemo`

The diff also includes the `.orca/runs/e57d1b9ce0b9.progress.json` run-progress file.
